steps.title: While you are completing the next …
steps.text: While you are completing the next quests and Slayer section, use up your Nature Runes alching as you go. — It doesn't matter what you alch, but if you want a bit of money then Volcanic ash is easy to get and alchs for 120 each. — The other runes can be used up or saved for later as you would like.

steps.title: Complete Ghosts Ahoy. — The Ectophial …
steps.text: Complete Ghosts Ahoy. — The Ectophial is close to the undead farm, where you can complete several of the tasks for Tureal

steps.title: Complete Lunar Diplomacy. — If you …
steps.text: Complete Lunar Diplomacy. — If you are missing any of the stats, get them however you would like. — Author Note: Going for Astral Contact with Lunars is a new addition to the guide. Let me know if I overlooked anything!

steps.title: If you have 85 Combat, complete …
steps.text: If you have 85 Combat, complete Dream Mentor

steps.title: Create a Lunar altar in your …
steps.text: Create a Lunar altar in your house. — (Optional) Go for a Pharaoh's sceptre and boost to make the Occult altar. It is really handy to have locked in early!

steps.title: Create a Mahogany eagle lectern in …
steps.text: Create a Mahogany eagle lectern in your house. — (Optional) Create a Marble lectern instead, but it costs a lot more

steps.title: Complete more quests until you have …
steps.text: Complete more quests until you have 250 Quest Points if you don't have it. — (Optional) Go for 300 Quest points for another block. You need all the quests done eventually anyway. — You can look ahead in the guide for quest ideas, there are plenty that could be easily done now rather than waiting until later.

steps.title: Make Super attack potions if you …
steps.text: Make Super attack potions if you have not already. — Remember your Dragon Battleaxe will cover Strength

steps.title: Make about ~250 Teleport to house …
steps.text: Make about ~250 Teleport to house (tablet)s. — This Video shows an easy method. — If you don't have Humidify you can make some Bracelets of Clay instead. — Make ~500 tablets if you plan to go for a 500 Task streak rather than 250.

steps.title: Do Slayer Point Boosting for starting …
steps.text: Do Slayer Point Boosting for starting points. Use Astral Contact to get tasks, and the portals or fairy ring in your house to get to each task. — Complete tasks with Tureal to build streak. — Complete the 10th task bonuses at Mazchna. — Complete the 50ths task bonuses at Konar. — Consider switching back to normal spellbook and using Bones to Peaches if it makes sense for your task. — Do this until your 250th or (Preferably) your 500th task. — You can make your own block lists with your least favorite tasks. — Remember that each master has their own block lists now.

steps.title: After you are done point boosting, …
steps.text: After you are done point boosting, continue training Slayer until level 58. — Use whatever master you want. — Once you reach 30 Slayer you can complete Slug Menace for the proselyte armour. — You can get to the altars through Guardians of the rift (pre-make the items as you can't bring in pure essence) or through the abyss. — If you have 60 Defense you can get a Dragon Defender. — Consider unlocking Vampyre tasks and use task storage on one for the Vampyre quest bosses later. — Mazchna can also assign it by default, so you might get one that way during point boosting.

steps.title: Kill Cave Horrors for a Black …
steps.text: Kill Cave Horrors for a Black mask

steps.title: Make a Slayer Helmet. — Imbue …
steps.text: Make a Slayer Helmet. — Imbue it. The method you use to imbue doesn't matter to the guide

steps.title: Obtain a Dragon Defender if you …
steps.text: Obtain a Dragon Defender if you have not done so yet

steps.title: Build the Master Stash unit in …
steps.text: Build the Master Stash unit in the Warriors Guild to to store your Slayer Helm, Battleaxe, and Defender
